paired_boundary_sensitivity_effect_chang.estimand: Within-output secondary-minus-primary measurement difference, then original paired-case contrast. Unknown deltas stay unknown; no difference of differently selected assessed-only means.
paired_boundary_sensitivity_effect_chang.limitation: Unknown-delta bounds can be conservative; no factual recoding or new primary endpoint.

scope: Exploratory measurement robustness; same 16 weights, six clusters. No independent boundary accuracy or pure-mechanism claim.
